grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: Lin Tao's Busy Week
instructions: 这是为A1学习者编写的原创模拟阅读练习，主题是日常安排与习惯。请先阅读短文，然后完成8道题。所有题目都是单选或填空。填空题的答案必须来自原文，并且不超过规定的词数。每题只能选一个答案。
passage:
A. My name is Lin Tao. I am a bus driver in a small city. I work five days a week. I start work at six in the morning. I drive my bus and I help many people every day.

B. On Monday, I get up at five. I eat bread and I drink tea. I go to work by bike. I finish work at two in the afternoon. In the evening, I study English at home. I like English.

C. On Saturday, I do not work. I visit my mother. We cook lunch together. We talk and we laugh. On Sunday, I play football with my friends. We always have fun. I am happy with my week.

questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“I am a bus driver in a small city.”，所以他是公交车司机。
questions.evidence: I am a bus driver in a small city.

questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“I work five days a week.”，所以是一周五天。
questions.evidence: I work five days a week.

questions.prompt: 林涛早上几点开始工作？
questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“I start work at six in the morning.”，所以是早上六点。
questions.evidence: I start work at six in the morning.

questions.prompt: 根据原文填空：On Monday, I get up at ______.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“On Monday, I get up at five.”，所以填 five。
questions.evidence: On Monday, I get up at five.

questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“I go to work by bike.”，所以是骑自行车。
questions.evidence: I go to work by bike.

questions.prompt: 根据原文填空：I finish work at ______ in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“I finish work at two in the afternoon.”，所以填 two。
questions.evidence: I finish work at two in the afternoon.

questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“On Saturday, I do not work. I visit my mother.”，所以星期六他看望妈妈。踢足球是星期日的事。
questions.evidence: On Saturday, I do not work. I visit my mother.

questions.prompt: 星期日林涛和谁一起踢足球？
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“On Sunday, I play football with my friends.”，所以是和朋友一起。
questions.evidence: On Sunday, I play football with my friends.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they + 实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时用来说习惯和每天做的事。主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形，不加 -s。例如“I work”“we cook”。否定句用 do not，例如“I do not work”。时间表达如 at six、on Monday 放在句子里说明时间。频率词如 always 表示“总是”。
grammar.example: I work five days a week.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get，不加 -s。
questions.evidence: On Monday, I get up at five.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 cook。

questions.prompt: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：They ______ football on Sunday. (play)
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，一般现在时动词用原形 play。
questions.evidence: On Sunday, I play football with my friends.

options: I do not work on Saturday.
I does not work on Saturday.
answers: I do not work on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，否定句用 do not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: On Saturday, I do not work.
